name: Helix
description: The undisputed crown jewel of Liseberg and one of the finest launch coasters in Europe — Helix is a Mack Rides multi-launch steel coaster that blasts riders through two linear synchronous motor launches and seven inversions across 1,378 metres of track. Named after its distinctive helix-shaped elements, the ride reaches speeds that push riders through corkscrews, a zero-g roll and dramatic near-miss moments with the park's own hillside terrain. Opened in 2014, Helix consistently ranks among the top steel coasters in the world and is the single biggest reason coaster enthusiasts travel to Gothenburg. Riding it after dark, with the city glowing below, is considered an entirely different experience. Min 140cm.

name: Balder
description: Repeatedly voted one of the world's best wooden roller coasters, Balder is an Intamin-designed masterpiece that launched in 2003 and immediately redefined what a wooden coaster could feel like. The ride reaches speeds of up to 120 km/h and delivers relentless airtime through its prefabricated wooden structure, blending traditional wooden-coaster texture with genuinely modern intensity. Named after the Norse god of light, Balder remains one of Liseberg's most beloved attractions two decades after opening. Min 140cm.

name: Valkyria
description: Europe's longest dive coaster, Valkyria opened in 2018 as a Bolliger & Mabillard creation that sends riders over a vertical 90-degree drop before plunging underground through a dramatic tunnel sequence. Named after the Valkyries of Norse mythology, the ride combines the suspended-seat dive coaster format with Liseberg's signature hillside terrain, creating moments of genuine weightlessness at the crest of every drop. One of the most photographed rides in the park. Min 130cm.

name: AtmosFear
description: One of the tallest free-fall drop towers in Europe, AtmosFear stands 116 metres above Liseberg and delivers a genuinely terrifying freefall with sweeping views across Gothenburg and the archipelago beyond. Riders are launched skyward before an extended moment of suspension at the top, followed by a rapid descent that has made it one of the most feared attractions in the park despite its deceptively simple format. Min 140cm.

name: Loke
description: A Bolliger & Mabillard wing coaster where riders sit in pairs extending beyond both sides of the track with nothing above or below their feet, creating a genuine sensation of open-air flight. Loke twists, banks and dives through a layout named after the Norse trickster god, delivering moments of weightlessness throughout. Min 130cm.

name: Mechanica
description: Liseberg's headline indoor dark ride combining physical sets with projection-mapped animation in an immersive steampunk narrative. Mechanica takes riders through a mechanical fantasy world blending practical effects with digital projection in a way that appeals equally to thrill-seekers and families. Covered by the park's virtual queue system due to consistently high demand. Suitable for all ages.

name: Luna
description: A family boomerang coaster where the train is pulled backwards up a lift hill before racing forward through the layout and then reversing the entire course. Short, sharp and surprisingly thrilling for a family-rated ride, Luna is a favourite entry point into coasters for younger riders at Liseberg. Min 120cm.

name: Stormvåg
description: Liseberg's headline addition for 2026 — Stormvåg, or Storm Wave, is an Art Engineering Wild Swing XL standing 14.5 metres tall with 24 sofa-style seats that swing riders through increasingly wild arcs. A genuinely new sensation for the park and one of the most talked-about new attractions of the season. Min 120cm.

name: Kaninlandet
description: Liseberg's dedicated children's area, home to the park's beloved bunny mascot. Kaninlandet is filled with gentle rides scaled for younger visitors, including Flygis and the classic Cyclone, in a colourful and welcoming environment designed specifically for families with young children. Open every weekend in 2026. Suitable for all ages.

name: Flygis
description: A classic gentle spinning plane ride in Kaninlandet where young riders control how high their aeroplane flies with a simple joystick. Timeless, simple and enduringly popular with the park's youngest visitors. Suitable for all ages.

name: Cyclone
description: A gentle spinning ride in Kaninlandet perfectly scaled for the park's youngest guests, offering a first taste of movement and speed in a completely safe, low-intensity format. A staple of the children's area since it opened. Suitable for all ages.

name: Spökhotellet Gasten
description: A spooky walkthrough ghost hotel experience themed around Liseberg's resident ghost mascot, Gasten. Guests wander through atmospheric haunted hotel corridors filled with playful scares suitable for the whole family — genuinely eerie without tipping into anything too intense for younger visitors. Suitable for all ages.

name: Pariserhjulet
description: Liseberg's classic big wheel offering sweeping panoramic views across Gothenburg, the harbour and on clear days the surrounding archipelago. A gentle, relaxed counterpoint to the park's thrill coasters and one of the best vantage points in the entire city. Suitable for all ages.
